title: Minimal Independent Evidence Set for Cause-Class Identifiability
canonical_question: What is the minimal additional set of independent evidence required to recover a cause class from an ambiguous output-symbol?

motivation.origin: An ambiguous punctate visual output can be compatible with multiple retinal, neural, optical, environmental, or particle-interaction causes; the useful general problem is therefore not naming one cause from one symbol, but determining which additional evidence makes the cause class identifiable.
motivation.epistemic_ceiling: This contract identifies the evidence needed to discriminate cause classes. It does not authorize a medical diagnosis, physical-cause claim, or causal claim from the output-symbol alone.

core_objects.C: finite or structured set of candidate cause classes
core_objects.y: observed output-symbol shared by two or more candidate causes
core_objects.E: universe of candidate additional evidence channels
core_objects.compatibility_set: K(y,S) = {c in C : c remains compatible with y and the observed evidence in S}
core_objects.target_partition: the desired granularity of cause classification; exact mechanism recovery is not required when class recovery is sufficient

minimal_identifiability_objective.definition: Find S* with minimum evidence cost such that the remaining compatible causes belong to exactly one target cause class and this conclusion survives independence and robustness gates.
minimal_identifiability_objective.cost_form: S* = argmin_S sum_i cost(e_i) subject to IDENTIFIABLE(y,S)=true
minimal_identifiability_objective.probabilistic_form: Where calibrated likelihoods exist, require posterior decision risk <= epsilon and a pre-registered separation margin between the winning class and all alternatives.
minimal_identifiability_objective.non_identifiability_rule: If two cause classes remain observationally equivalent under every admissible evidence subset, verdict = NON_IDENTIFIABLE_UNDER_CURRENT_MEASUREMENT_MODEL, not NEGATIVE.

dimensions.name: provenance_independence
dimensions.question: Did the evidence arise from distinct acquisition or analysis lineages rather than copies or transformations of the same source?

dimensions.name: failure_mode_independence
dimensions.question: Can one latent fault, artifact, bias, or preprocessing step generate all selected witnesses simultaneously?

dimensions.name: mechanism_orthogonality
dimensions.question: Do the witnesses interrogate different consequences of the candidate cause rather than repeatedly measuring one consequence?

dimensions.name: modality_independence
dimensions.question: When possible, are distinct physical or informational modalities used?

dimensions.name: interventional_independence
dimensions.question: Does at least one witness come from a controlled perturbation or counterfactual test when intervention is feasible and safe?

independence_contract.hard_warning: Statistical conditional independence alone is neither necessary nor sufficient for epistemic independence of evidence channels.

pairwise_discrimination_matrix.construction: For every pair of target cause classes (c_i,c_j), record which evidence channels can distinguish them under the declared assumptions.
pairwise_discrimination_matrix.coverage_rule: Every unresolved pair must be separated by at least one valid witness family; high-risk claims should require more than one failure-mode-independent separator.
pairwise_discrimination_matrix.set_cover_interpretation: The minimal evidence problem can be represented as a weighted set-cover or hitting-set problem over unresolved cause-class pairs.
pairwise_discrimination_matrix.anti_shortcut: A witness that distinguishes many pairs but shares one catastrophic failure mode with the output channel must not automatically dominate the set.

PASS: The target cause class is uniquely determined at the predeclared granularity under the measurement model.
Every rival target class is separated by explicit evidence rather than absence of unexplained evidence.
The selected witness set passes the independence contract.
Leave-one-out minimality is evaluated: removing any witness either breaks identifiability or demonstrates that the removed witness was redundant.
Alternative plausible measurement models have been stress-tested where material.
identifiability_gate.PARTIAL: Some cause classes are excluded but two or more target classes remain observationally compatible.
identifiability_gate.UNKNOWN_RESOURCE_LIMIT: The required evidence exists in principle but was not acquired or processed due resource or access limits.
identifiability_gate.NON_IDENTIFIABLE_UNDER_CURRENT_MEASUREME: No admissible witness set separates the remaining classes under current assumptions.
identifiability_gate.FAIL_INVALID_EVIDENCE: The apparent discrimination depends on leakage, duplicated provenance, circular inference, invalid controls, or a shared unmodeled failure mode.

minimality_tests.leave_one_out: For each e in S*, recompute identifiability on S*\{e}.
minimality_tests.permutation_negative_control: Where sequence/order carries meaning, permute evidence order or labels to test whether the discriminator depends on accidental ordering conventions.
minimality_tests.duplicate_lineage_control: Replace one witness with a derivative of another; the independence score must fall and should not create a stronger verdict.
minimality_tests.null_symbol_control: Run the same selector on outputs lacking the target symbol to estimate spurious cause-class recovery.
minimality_tests.adversarial_common_cause_control: Introduce or simulate a shared artifact capable of contaminating multiple witnesses and verify that the gate detects the dependency.

eye_punctate_flash.output_symbol: brief punctate flash or pixel-like percept
useful_witness_examples: relationship to eye movement or mechanical pressure
external detector coincidence if specifically testing particle hypotheses
eye_punctate_flash.safety_note: This is a research discrimination framework, not a diagnostic protocol. New persistent flashes, floaters, field loss, or other concerning visual changes warrant professional eye evaluation.

computer_vision.output_symbol: detected object, pixel anomaly, segmentation region, or classifier token

forensics.output_symbol: trace compatible with several causal histories

search_and_proof_systems.output_symbol: candidate answer, witness, proof state, or apparent recurrence

machine.name: AMBIGUOUS-SYMBOL-TO-CAUSE-CLASS
machine.compact_form: SYMBOL -> HYPOTHESIS_SET -> DISCRIMINATOR_SET -> INDEPENDENCE_GATE -> MINIMUM_WITNESS_SET -> CLASS_RECOVERY -> VERIFY

research_grounding.reference: Bareinboim and Pearl, Causal inference and the data-fusion problem, PNAS 2016
research_grounding.relevance: Formalizes identifiability and combining heterogeneous data sources.

research_grounding.reference: Gresele et al., The Incomplete Rosetta Stone problem: Identifiability results for Multi-view Nonlinear ICA, UAI 2020
research_grounding.relevance: Shows that multiple sufficiently different noisy views can make latent-source recovery identifiable when a single view cannot.

research_grounding.reference: Yan and Chen, Sensor Selection via Maximizing Hybrid Bayesian Fisher Information and Mutual Information in Unreliable Sensor Networks, Electronics 2020
research_grounding.relevance: Connects sensor subset selection with information gain and uncertainty reduction.

research_grounding.reference: Multiple Indicators, Multiple Causes Measurement Error Models
research_grounding.relevance: Emphasizes that identifiability of latent causal quantities requires additional information about the measurement process.

next_executable_stage.goal: Build a domain-agnostic solver that accepts candidate cause classes and evidence channels, constructs a pairwise discrimination matrix, penalizes dependent witnesses, and returns the lowest-cost witness set plus unresolved pairs and falsification controls.
next_executable_stage.verdict_ceiling: IDENTIFIABILITY_CANDIDATE_ONLY until replayed on at least one synthetic benchmark with known causes and one real cross-domain benchmark.

provenance.relationship_to_r3: Generalizes R3 hidden-machine falsification from detecting shared operator machines to determining the minimal independent evidence needed to distinguish rival causal explanations for the same observable output.
provenance.preservation_rule: Future refinements must supersede rather than silently rewrite this contract.
